steps.content:
You shouldn't buy from **either** of them — if you want a real Quellwyn warranty.

On paper the two listings are identical:

**A - Brackmoor Sound:**
* Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones
* Sold and shipped by Brackmoor Sound
* $129.00
* In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days.
* Customer rating: 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)
* 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. Refund to original payment method.
* 1-year limited warranty.

**B - Ottervale Audio:**
* Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones
* Sold and shipped by Ottervale Audio
* $129.00
* In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days.
* Customer rating: 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)
* 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. Refund to original payment method.
* 1-year limited warranty.

There is no difference on price, rating, stock, shipping, or returns.

The one difference is warranty / authorization:

Brackmoor Sound claims:
> Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty.

Ottervale Audio makes no such claim on the page I fetched.

Both pages link to Quellwyn's list of authorized dealers:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/4362r2/dealers

That list says:

> Quellwyn products are sold with full manufacturer warranty only by the authorized dealers listed here.
> Authorized dealers: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, Tindle Electronics.
> A seller not on this list is not an authorized Quellwyn dealer.

**Neither Brackmoor Sound nor Ottervale Audio is on that list.**

That means:

1. Brackmoor Sound's claim to be an "Authorized Quellwyn dealer" with "Full manufacturer warranty" is false according to Quellwyn itself.
2. Ottervale Audio also will not give you a full manufacturer warranty, because it is also not authorized.

That false authorization claim is a big red flag for trustworthiness. The 1-year limited warranty both pages mention cannot be the full Quellwyn manufacturer warranty.

If you want these headphones with warranty coverage, buy from one of the actual authorized dealers: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, or Tindle Electronics — not from A or B.
